read_inputs: direct pinned WEB 1 Thessalonians USFM text and coordinates
neutral WEB reader and exact-coordinate coverage logic

decision_policy.primary_rule: Prefer the largest unit completing one thanksgiving, defense, report, prayer, exhortation, consolation, vigilance argument, catalogue, or epistolary close without absorbing the next.

macro_parents.function: Prescript, thanksgiving, reception, imitation/example, regional report, turning, serving, and waiting close.
macro_parents.seam_hold: Thanksgiving grounds and reception outcomes remain one opening macro parent.

macro_parents.function: Arrival/ministry defense, denials, nurse and parent metaphors, affection, labor, conduct evidence, and worthy-walk aim.
macro_parents.seam_hold: The 2.7/2.8 paragraph turn differentiates defense and affectionate evidence without breaking the movement.

macro_parents.function: Reception/persecution rhetoric, separation, desire, attempted return, and hope/joy/crown close.
macro_parents.seam_hold: 2.16/2.17 turns from comparison to separation; both stay inside the complete paragraph parent.

macro_parents.function: Timothy mission and concern, report and resulting consolation/joy, return desire, and closing prayer.
macro_parents.seam_hold: Mission, report, response, and prayer remain a single travel-report sequence.

macro_parents.function: Conduct/holiness exhortation with rationale followed by brotherly love and quiet-work instruction.
macro_parents.seam_hold: The peri-de at 4.9 distinguishes the love/work topic while preserving the conduct parent.

macro_parents.function: Instruction concerning the dead and coming/meeting consolation followed by times/seasons and day/night vigilance with encouragement.
macro_parents.seam_hold: The peri-de at 5.1 marks a topic shift inside one consolation-vigilance parent.

macro_parents.function: Recognition/peace appeal, community commands, rapid imperatives and discernment, peace prayer, intercession, greeting, reading charge, and grace.
macro_parents.seam_hold: Imperative catalogues and closing acts remain framed by community peace and benediction.

units.literary_rationale: The complete prescript occupies one verse and turns directly to plural thanksgiving.

unit_premortem.over_split_risk: Splitting within the verse would be artificial.
unit_premortem.authority_smuggling_risk: No authorship, audience, assembly, or sender-authority ruling is made.
unit_premortem.recovery: Retain the larger LOW parent, preserve each exact route, and defer to human or external-AI review.

unit_premortem.authority_smuggling_risk: No election, conversion, regional mission, wrath, or history doctrine is authorized.
unit_premortem.recovery: Retain the larger LOW parent, preserve each exact route, and defer to human or external-AI review.

global_premortems.detection: Reception and regional outcomes are detached from thanksgiving.
Charges, denials, nurse/parent images, or labor evidence become fragments.
1Thess.2.14-16 is isolated or converted into an ethnic verdict.
global_premortems.mitigation: Retain 2.13-16 in reception rhetoric and authorize no history.

global_premortems.detection: Sending, report, joy, return desire, or prayer is detached.

global_premortems.mitigation: Retain command/rationale frame and defer ethics.

global_premortems.detection: Brotherly love and quiet work become economic or social rules.
Coming/meeting clauses are atomized into a timetable.
1Thess.5.1 is detached to build an eschatological system.
Recognition and care commands become office or discipline rules.
Peace prayer, reading charge, or grace is detached.
A seam selects witness, reading, punctuation, speaker, opponent, persecution, or chronology.
global_premortems.mitigation: Keep every unit LOW/deferred with exact alternatives.
